entries.claim: For every finite equal-mass cluster C of N points in the declared affine Euclidean lattice realization, I2(C)=sum_x ||x-g||^2=(1/N) sum_{x<y} ||x-y||^2; hence G=N I2=sum_{x<y} Q(x-y) is an exact nonnegative integer.
entries.evidence: algebraic expansion; executable fast-form versus pairwise checks in checker

entries.claim: For S=sum_C x, d=v-u and L the polar form L((a,b),(c,d))=2ac+ad+bc+2bd, one replacement u->v satisfies DeltaG=N(Q(v)-Q(u))-[L(S,d)+Q(d)].
entries.evidence: direct expansion of G=N sum Q(x)-Q(S); checked per accepted move

entries.claim: Every D1 or D2 trajectory under the frozen strict rule terminates after finitely many accepted moves because G is a nonnegative integer and strictly decreases by at least 1 at every accepted move. The fixed-N translation+D6 state quotient is also finite.

Starting from hole-free C, for Cprime=(C\{u}) union {v}, let R=C\{u}, assume Cprime is connected, let k be the number of occupied components of R, and c the number of cyclic occupied-neighbor runs of v in R. Under the frozen six-neighbor exterior test, Cprime is hole-free iff c=k.
entries.evidence: planar triangular-lattice articulation/run argument; exhaustive candidate cross-check against padded flood fill through all N<=8 classes with zero mismatches

entries.claim: Not every D1 local minimum is D2-minimal. Smallest exact counterexample occurs at N=6; two of the three D1 minima admit strict D2 improvement.
entries.evidence: R055_SMALL_N_EXHAUSTIVE_ATLAS.json; explicit G=33 ->29 and G=30 ->29 D2 escapes

entries.claim: D1 terminal class is not independent of initial state. At N=6 there are three exact D1 local minima; taking them as initial states yields three inequivalent terminal classes. All 13 construction N also show multiple primary terminal classes across frozen starts.

D1 terminal class is not tie-break independent. At N=6 an exact starting class reaches different D1 terminal classes under T0 versus T1/T2; each of the 13 construction N has a frozen-family tie-dependence witness.

A unique D1 attractor/terminal shape does not exist in general. Exact counterexample at N=6; moreover an infinite centered-shell subsequence has a provable nonglobal D1 trap for every shell radius r>=6.

D1 terminal centroid class is not unique in general. The N=6 D1 minima already have distinct centroid residue/D6 stabilizer classes; all construction N have multiple primary terminal centroid classes.

entries.boundary: This does not disprove the stronger inclusion hypothesis global-G-minimizer subset global-P_edge-minimizers, which remains true in N<=12 data and is not proved all-N.
entries.claim: The exact global G-minimizer set need not equal the exact global P_edge-minimizer set. At N=6 the G minimizer is unique while P_edge has three minimizer classes (including the G minimizer); set inequality recurs at N=9 and N=11 within N<=12.

Strict accepted decrease of G does not monotonically improve P_edge, A2, boundary squared-radius dispersion, or six-direction imbalance. Each diagnostic has an explicit worsening step already on N=19 ELONGATED_STRIP primary D1.

Let H_r={ (a,b): max(|a|,|b|,|a+b|)<=r } with N_r=1+3r(r+1). For every r>=1, H_r is a D1 local minimum of G. D6 symmetry gives S=0. Any nearest-neighbor move to an empty site crosses the shell boundary and has Q(v)-Q(u)>=r+1, while Q(v-u)=1, so DeltaG>=N_r(r+1)-1>0.

For every r>=6, H_r is not D2-minimal. Remove u=(-r,0) and add v=(ceil((r+1)/2),floor((r+1)/2)); the relocation is connected and hole-free. For r=2k>=6, DeltaG=-2k(6k^3-15k^2-8k-1)<0. For r=2k+1>=7, DeltaG=-(2k+1)(6k^3-6k^2-17k-7)<0.

For every centered-shell count N_r with r>=6, D1 has at least two inequivalent terminal states: H_r itself and the D1 terminal reached after first taking the strict D2-improving state from R055-T06. Their G values differ, so they cannot be translation+D6 equivalent. Hence exact D1 metastability persists along an infinite N subsequence.

Even D2 strict relocation need not select one terminal class from the tested construction starts. Multiple D2 terminal G/classes are observed at N=31,53,91,113,127,151,169,217 depending on whether D2 starts from frozen initial states or D1 terminals.
entries.scope: construction N; not an exact all-state counterexample unless separately exhausted

Existence of one rescaled D1 terminal limit shape independent of initial state.

entries.claim: Whether every exact global G minimizer is also a P_edge minimizer for all N.
entries.evidence: true for exhaustive N<=12 only; minimizer-set equality already false.

entries.claim: Whether global/D2 minimizer centroids are restricted asymptotically to a finite family of symmetry residue classes.
entries.evidence: D1 terminals include generic stabilizer-1 centroid classes, so no such restriction holds for arbitrary D1 terminal states.
